title: 第3770章 圣城暗涌情急逃亡第3769章 商禾忧父禁地隐情
content_zh:
第3770章圣城暗涌，情急逃亡
商书言走下高台，来到商禾旁边轻声细语地劝解道。
说完之后，商禾面色如常，脑海中却联想到了另外一件事儿。
商禾眉头紧锁，低声开口道。
“爹，是最近其他圣城的动作很大吗？”
“不然……你怎么会有这么大的压力。”
商书言并未否认，他眼眸低垂，眸光闪烁着冰冷的寒芒，眯着眼沉声道。
“最近几大圣城隐隐有联手的趋势，想要对付我等。”
“哼！”
“他们未免也太小瞧我清幽了！！”
商禾眉头一皱，她没想到如今清幽的局势竟然如此紧张。
冷哼一声，商禾眼中闪烁着杀意，寒声道。
“爹，要不要我这次跟你一起去？”
商书言闻言哈哈大笑。
“哈哈哈。”
商书言伸手拍了拍商禾的肩膀，轻声笑道。
“你爹还没到那么狼狈的时候，怎可能让我宝贝女儿亲自上场？”
“到时候还没开打，你爹怕是要被别人笑话死。”
商书言可舍不得自己女儿上战场。
虽然商禾的实力地放眼十六座圣城的冥王级强者里都不弱，但他也不会让商禾上战场。

这一点，段浩川和商书言几乎一模一样。
这俩人的骨子里都有一种特殊的‘大男子’主义。
他们认为自己身为男人，身为父亲，若是让商禾出手，那就是他们自己没本事！
商书言单手负后，笑着说道。
“圣城之外的事儿就不需要你操心了。”
“如今圣城上下被你打理得井井有条，已经做得很好了。”
商书言声音颇为感慨的说道。
“有你在管理着圣城，我在外面的时候也十分放心。”
商禾闻言也不敢开口多说什么。
商书言到现在都不知道商禾到底闯了多大的祸。
沈清瑶转化冥修，从紧急山脉遁走不知所踪。
李贯阳亲儿子李观棋死了，神魂进入了黄泉界……
这事儿若是说出去，整个黄泉界必定被掀得天翻地覆。
就算是十六圣城这个级别都要被震动，甚至惊动十殿阎罗。
商禾如今也不敢把这件事儿告诉商书言。
content_en:
Chapter 3770: Undercurrent in the Holy City, desperate to escape
Shang Shuyan walked down the high platform, came to Shang He's side and softly persuaded him.
After finishing speaking, Shang He's expression remained as usual, but another thing came to mind.
Shang He frowned and spoke in a low voice.
"Dad, are other holy cities making big moves recently?"
"Otherwise...why would you be under so much pressure?"
Shang Shuyan did not deny it. He lowered his eyes with an icy cold light and said in a deep voice while squinting.
"Recently, there is a faint tendency for several major holy cities to join forces and want to deal with me and others."
"Hmph!"
"They underestimate me Qingyou too much!!"
Shang He frowned, she didn't expect the situation in Qingyou to be so tense now.
With a cold snort, Shang He said in a cold voice with murderous intent flashing in his eyes.
"Dad, do you want me to go with you this time?"
Shang Shuyan burst into laughter upon hearing this.
"Hahaha."
Shang Shuyan reached out and patted Shang He on the shoulder, laughing softly.
"How could your father let my precious daughter play in person when he is not in such a state of embarrassment?"
"The fight hasn't started yet, and your father will probably be laughed to death by others."
Shang Shuyan couldn't bear to let his daughter go to the battlefield.
Although Shang He's strength is not weak among the Pluto-level powerhouses in the sixteen holy cities, he will not let Shang He go to the battlefield.
In this regard, Duan Haochuan and Shang Shuyan are almost identical.
Both of these people have a special kind of 'macho'ism in their bones.
They think that as men and fathers, if Shang He takes action, it means they are incompetent!
Shang Shuyan put one hand behind his back and said with a smile.
"You don't need to worry about things outside the Holy City."
"Now that the Holy City is in good order, you have done a great job."
Shang Shuyan said with emotion.
"With you in charge of the Holy City, I feel very at ease when I'm outside."
Shang He didn't dare to say anything after hearing this.
Shang Shuyan still doesn't know how much trouble Shang He got into.
Shen Qingyao turned to meditation and escaped from the Emergency Mountains without a trace.
Li Guanyang's biological son Li Guanqi died, and his soul entered the underworld...
If this matter were told, the entire underworld would be turned upside down.
Even the level of the Sixteenth Holy City would be shaken, and even the Ten Palaces of Yama would be alarmed.
Shang He did not dare to tell Shang Shuyan about this now.
